scenes.narration: Look at a curved surface in space. An orthogonal slice exposes a partial derivative curve, while the tangent plane rests flat against the surface at a point.

visual.heading: Partial slices & tangent plane
visual.caption: Slices isolate one variable; tangent planes capture both slopes.

scenes.narration: To compute the volume under a dome, pack vertical Riemann columns beneath the surface, or stack discrete voxels in three dimensions.

visual.heading: Double & triple integral volume
visual.caption: Summing columns approximates double integrals; voxels approximate triple integrals.
